_provenance.note: A forced non-ok response cannot be recorded from a successful API call — hand-authored to exercise gitlabApiFetch's `!res.ok` throw (gitlab-api.mjs:65), which gitlab.mjs#prReviews catches and normalizes to null. `null` (uncomputable) must never collapse to a fabricated `[]`: the L6 brain-writes-reviewed gate distinguishes 'nobody approved' from 'could not fetch', and cold-boot's priorVerdicts load does the same for the verdict thread.
